title: Getting Started with AI
content:
• Home

AI Fluency Starts Here

 It’s not about becoming a tech expert. It’s about understanding how AI works—and how to make it work for you.

Get the AI Starter Guide Watch the Recent Live Show

Why It Matters

You Can’t Lead What You Don’t Understand

In the next two years, AI will reshape 85 million jobs. Are you embracing the change—or reacting to it?

AI is already embedded in how we search, hire, write, and decide.

Those fluent in AI will lead teams, drive innovation, and stay relevant.

This is your career advantage—starting now.

What Is AI Literacy?

It’s not coding. It’s comprehension.

It’s not hype. It’s practical.

It’s how you lead with confidence in a digital-first world.

Watch the Live Show on AI Literacy

🧠 AI Fluency Matters

AI fluency means you understand what AI can do, where it fits in your business, and how to use it—without needing to be a data scientist.

Here’s why that matters:

AI is Already Driving Decisions

From hiring tools to content generation to forecasting—AI is shaping your business whether you engage with it or not.

Your Team Is Waiting on You

 Leaders who are AI fluent can ask better questions, avoid bad tools, and build smarter strategies.

Fluency Builds Credibility

Whether in boardrooms or client conversations, being able to speak AI sets you apart from those still guessing.

AI Will Reshape Work

 The World Economic Forum estimates that 85 million roles will be redefined by AI by 2025. If you're not learning, you're losing ground.

How to Start

The 4-Step Fluency Path

Break down the process for accessibility and action:

o1

Understand the
Language

 Decode terms like LLMs, models, and automation.

o2

Use AI Hands-
On

Simple tools to build confidence, not confusion.

o3

Connect It to Your
Work

See exactly where AI fits into your role.

o4

Grow as a
Leader

Turn fluency into influence.

Get the AI Starter Guide Now

Download the AI Starter Checklist

No jargon. No theory. Just tools you can use today.

Includes: AI terms decoded, tools to try, tasks to build confidence, and next steps to keep going.
